guidance: No script owns this violation kind - triage: either identify the right domain and say so, or escalate to human with a render and a one-paragraph explanation.

violations.msg: Library symbols type nearly every pin 'passive' (all U1 GPIOs/NRST/BOOT0/OSC pins, headers, diodes, crystal), so the green ERC 0/0 gate could not have caught driver conflicts, floating driven inputs, or signal-to-rail shorts - machine coverage is vacuous and future boards from these symbols are unguarded.

scope: fix ONLY these violations; do not touch unrelated nets/regions; re-run the failed gate when done
